intro: Lesson 43: Component 1 timed: the 30-mark anthology comparison. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: One word here: which partner did you choose?

questions.a: A partner poem and a four-line plan.
questions.model: Teacher reminder only: 'Remember and Do not go gentle: two sonnet-like forms of control facing death, one accepting, one raging.'

questions.q: in the portal response box, write your comparison. Starter: 'Remember, a Petrarchan sonnet, ...'
questions.a: Marked with 4ET1 Section B criteria. Points: Rossetti's sonnet turns at the volta from 'Remember me' to 'Better by far you should forget and smile'; selfless love; the partner's contrasting response to loss (e.g. Thomas's 'Rage, rage against the dying of the light'); form as control; integrated methods and a synthesised judgement.
questions.model: No model during the timed answer; a labelled model is shared in the feedback lesson.
